comparison: Old and roundtrip ring/query coordinates: original, point-only, edge-only, both. Certify by observed relative endpoint envelopes, no projection error model.
limits: planar byte observations, not projected straight-edge or geodesic equivalence; no geometry-changing repairs or threshold adjustment after observation
operation: EPSG:4326 to EPSG:3857 to EPSG:4326, traditional GIS axis order; apply same round-trip to all vertices and probes; persist/reopen round-tripped polygons as EPSG:4326 in disposable GeoPackage
oracle: exact dyadic ring simplicity and point category independently on original and round-tripped coordinate records; distinguish predicate error at one representation from category change between representations
probes: Predeclare every exact binary64 edge midpoint, signed y offsets by 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256 observed ULPS at midpoint, and fixed 3x3 interior bounding-box lattice; one component within fixed FIDs.
selection: countries FIDs 1,2,3,4,9,10, first simple non-hole component of at most 80 vertices with all latitudes in [-80,80] and longitudes strictly between -180 and 180; record exclusions
